environment: Flutter test VM with native File.readAsBytes; not a physical device or browser
interpretation: Both runs show that five distinct cell summaries and one repeated-cell request shared one selected chlorophyll entry, causing one chlorophyll CSV read. The before-fix run read all 24 entries for each of its two distinct cells (48 chlorophyll CSV reads). Base initialization plus the first selected-cell value took 661-1,229 ms across these two runs; the first selected-cell call took 157-268 ms after initialization had begun warming entry 1.
limits: Two local runs; elapsed times depend on machine load and filesystem cache, so treat the range as directional.
The first selected-entry load can share the background preload started by initialize; combined time is more comparable than its isolated call time.
Geometry after uses a reusable indexed lookup with a warm per-cell cache. Its 9 ms loop is not directly comparable to the before-fix free-function intersections, which measured 68 ms.
This measures repository/domain work through Flutter's VM test harness. It does not measure widget rebuilds, map rendering, frame time, or mobile-device storage latency.
